name: assumptions
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
ASSUME PrintT("first")
ASSUME Print(1, TRUE)
ASSUME PrintT("last")
====

name: short-circuit
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
ASSUME TRUE \/ PrintT("hidden")
ASSUME FALSE => PrintT("also hidden")
ASSUME PrintT("shown")
====

name: operator-argument
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
Apply(F(_), x) == F(x)
ASSUME Apply(PrintT, "called")
====

name: initial
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
VARIABLE x
Init == /\ x = 0 /\ PrintT("initial")
Next == UNCHANGED x
====

name: action
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
Next == IF x = 0 THEN /\ PrintT("next") /\ x' = 1 ELSE /\ PrintT("done") /\ UNCHANGED x
====

name: invariant
source:
---- MODULE M ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
Next == x' = 1
Inv == Print("value", x) >= 0
====
config: INIT Init NEXT Next INVARIANT Inv
